cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: I Started the Spiral
cards.instruction: Hide how much your own fear or resentment created the emotional crisis while helping everyone calm it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. The club money's in the other envelope. Let's tell everyone they can stop worrying. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You phoned me crying that the treasurer had stolen it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. And you're the first person I'm reassuring. Could you pass on that it's all accounted for?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I told the whole committee what you said.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll ring them together. Could you introduce it as a routine balance update? No need to replay the tears.

mechanism: A confidently organizes reassurance about found money but changes the calling plan to keep B alongside while minimizing A tearful theft accusation.
confusable: Unlike innocent bookkeeping correction, A own fear created the crisis; borrowed authority recruits B help in a face-saving corrective call.
comparison: An angry treasurer and committee rumor differ from the fair actual transport cancellations.
seedUse: D109-b other envelope and tearful accusation; S02-b changes the method to retain the partner cooperation.
